_comment: Every other query in TestTrack is equality-only, which Firestore serves by intersecting
single-field indexes — no composite needed, and that is not an accident: proofs are read by
(appId, ownerUid) or (testerUid, groupId, day), apps by (ownerUid, status). Keeping to
equalities is what lets the whole thing deploy with an empty index list.
The events feed is the one exception. AdminEvents asks for 'addressed to me, newer than the
last one I raised', which is an equality plus a range on a different field, and that always
needs a composite. Without it the query fails FAILED_PRECONDITION and admin decisions never
reach the device — silently, because the drain swallows its errors so a bad feed cannot break
